answer.explanation: The domain entity Ticket imports the concrete UuidGenerator from the outbound adapters layer and instantiates it in its constructor. This makes the domain core depend on an adapter, not on a port, so the dependency points the wrong way. FF-S04 flags core code importing from adapters-outbound. ADR-0005 would permit this import, but its status is Proposed, so it is not a current decision. It grants no exception and declares no intent. No other doc or comment declares a rule on this. Because nothing current is declared, severity is ranked by what the dependency does: the domain core depends on an adapter, which is high.
